item.tib: sngags kyi mdo 'dur rin chen phreng ba mu cho khroms 'dur gyi bca' thabs lag len
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yang bkra shis smin grol khrod du bsgres rgan dznyā na hra dha'i lag rtsed du bris pa mdo smad rgyam khyung dge bshes tshang gi lugs so
item.note: the title given in ytkc differs: sngags kyi mdo 'dur rin chen phreng ba las mu cho'i khrom 'dur chen mo lag len 'khrul ba rgya grol. pp. 9-10 are two separate and unrelated 'appended texts,' probably pages missing from some other text.
